scope: supplemental continuous annotated meeting speech; separate from the frozen 128+128 qualification set
boundary_rule: annotation start/end candidates only; floor and ceil to 16 kHz sample positions; first sample within 15 seconds after anchor or anchor+target that lies inside no protected interval on any speaker; an anchor already in silence is not an extra candidate; fail acquisition when absent; retain continuous samples, pauses, overlap and speaker turns

ami.protected_intervals: every original speech segment, including segments without lexical words; preserve exact XML decimal times
ami.reference: timed w elements referenced by the original segments; all words must have exactly one containing segment; retain original word shape and truncation/mispronunciation attributes; record gaps separately

known_boundary_acquisition_failures.reason: no safe original segment boundary within the frozen 15-second window

aishell4.license_note: The mirror card labels Apache-2.0; dataset use follows the original publisher CC-BY-SA-4.0 statement. Original-WAV and mirror-FLAC decoded equivalence is not yet verified.
aishell4.protected_intervals: every nonempty original TextGrid IntervalTier interval on all six speakers; preserve original decimal precision; RTTM is a rounded cross-check only

reference_markers.rule: remove marker literals only, retain all other text and per-interval marker metadata; never discard a whole utterance for invalid speech, partial words or overlap
reference_markers.uncertainty: invalid-speech and partial-word intervals are not fully determined lexical truth; overlapping utterance order is deterministic reference order, not a word-interleaving claim
